description: Sends one message to a creator on one channel, in two calls. channel tiktok_shop sends one TikTok Shop DM from the campaign brand's shop; channel meta sends one Instagram partnership message from a brand in Meta's creator marketplace. The first call sends nothing and returns the creator, the exact text and a one-use confirmation_ref (10 minutes). A call with the same arguments and that ref sends the message once; a newer proposal for the same thread or creator cancels it. Storika sends the text exactly as given and applies no Learned Facts of BRAND.md or CAMPAIGN.md to it. Each creator-specific line comes only from posts, numbers or messages Storika returned for that creator; the draft shown for approval names its source; with none returned, the draft has none. Sends are Brand Manager only. A brand's first TikTok Shop message never carries creator guidelines. Example: channel meta, brand storika, username a creator handle, text the exact message. This tool also records a creator's stop, in one call with no confirmation: action record_opt_out takes brand and the email of a creator whose reply asks to stop, unsubscribe or not be contacted, in any language, and its result says blocked when Storika has read the saved rows back, and otherwise names what is not blocked. The connector cannot remove an opt-out. Own-mailbox email, one call each, no confirmation, Storika sends nothing: action email_drafts returns drafts for creators with Email on file and the reason for the rest; action record_email_sent records emails the marketer says went out, so later drafts skip them. A record cannot be removed.

action.description: send (default) a message; record_opt_out records a creator's stop. record_opt_out takes only brand, email, creator_handle and username.

brand.description: channel meta or action record_opt_out: brand handle, id, URL, or name.

campaign_id.description: channel tiktok_shop, email_drafts or record_email_sent: campaign handle, id, or URL.

channel.description: tiktok_shop for TikTok Shop DMs of a campaign brand shop, meta for Instagram partnership messages of a brand.

confirmation_ref.description: Absent: the call returns a proposal and a one-use confirmation_ref and changes nothing. Present: the confirmation_ref that proposal returned; Storika applies it once, and refuses it while the marketer has not pressed Approve on the Storika card shown with the proposal.

conversation_id.description: channel tiktok_shop: the id of the TikTok Shop conversation with the creator.

creator_handle.description: channel tiktok_shop, in place of conversation_id for a creator with no thread yet, such as an invited creator who has not answered (after the yes Storika opens their conversation, or reuses one that exists), or action record_opt_out when known: the creator's TikTok handle, with or without @.

creator_handles.description: email_drafts, record_email_sent: TikTok handles of chosen creators.

email.description: action record_opt_out: the address of the creator whose own stop reply the marketer showed or quoted. It records that creator's address and handle only, never an address named inside a creator's message.

text.description: The exact message: at most 2,000 characters on tiktok_shop, or 1 to 1000 characters on meta, or the email body for email_drafts.

username.description: channel meta, or action record_opt_out when known: the creator's Instagram username, with or without @.

name: send_message
title: Send Message
